scope: Review and repair of native component runner. Does not retroactively modify already running old runner instances or claim service/HTTPS acceptance.

initialFindings.issue: Timeout/termination killed Cargo only, while descendants and temporary files could remain; cleanup was unconditionally reported true.
initialFindings.resolution: Each Popen creates its own session; group members are bound to the creation tick and each original process is pinned with pidfd before signal; TERM/KILL finally is bounded; TERM/HUP enter cleanup. Unique mode0700 TMPDIR/TMP/TEMP is removed only after original group cleanup. Prefix-scoped DB/role residual or failed postcheck is FAIL; runner never deletes databases.

initialFindings.issue: Only current project inputs were verified; cross-project canonical SQL and helper binaries were not bound. Ambient Cargo/Rust overrides could affect execution.
initialFindings.resolution: Verify every snapshot input before and after, bind build-attestation and CLI/notification/Node binary hashes, use environment allowlist and explicit configuration.

executedChecks.name: Unrelated root HTTPS resource prefixes are excluded from component leak classification
Parent exits leaving sleeping grandchild and inherited pipe: timeout removes original group
SIGTERM during sleeping owned subprocess enters finally and removes original group

limits: Identity/platform instances started before the repair are not reclassified by this review. Their component evidence needs a separate current-input and resource-audit supplement.
No global or prefix-wide database deletion is performed. Exact residual ownership recovery remains with the environment coordinator.
The process checks executed inline import the runner; they do not execute Rust suites.

changes: Exact Rust selector and bounded Cargo integration target arguments
Selected/integration outputs use separate suffix and fullServiceSuiteClaimed=false

executedChecks.name: Exact current TLS selector runs only its named case
Nonexistent exact selector runs zero tests and must return FAIL despite Cargo success
executedChecks.cleanup: unique temporary directory removed, process group cleanup PASS, zero DB/role differences

executedChecks.name: Python AST syntax of final runner

incrementalReview.resourceNotes: The negative test only reads owned PG metadata. It creates one unique native temporary runtime directory, removes it, and creates no databases/roles/containers. Prior process regressions were not repeated.
